decisions.message: On Sat Dec 12, 00:00 to Sun Dec 13, about 12:00 Central, we move to a new banking system: your balance stays visible, but transfers, P2P payments and new cards pause. It may run some hours longer; we will post updates in the app. During the system move, card payments work offline up to $250 each (raised from $100). We have added 150 support staff for the coming weeks.
decisions.why:
Chosen by the optimizer for week 5 (everyone).
Actions: Offline card limit during migration $100 -> $250, Extra support staff for 4 weeks.
Cost $800,000 of the $4M budget.

actions.action: Savings rate boost for 4 weeks, balances up to $50,000

decisions.message: Thank you for your patience in recent weeks. For the next 4 weeks, Cobalt savings earn an extra 0.25 points on balances up to $50,000.
